def build(p):
    def hexagon(af):
        return [(af/math.sqrt(3)*math.cos(math.radians(30+60*i)), af/math.sqrt(3)*math.sin(math.radians(30+60*i))) for i in range(6)]
    def prism(af,z,h):
        return cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z).polyline(hexagon(af)).close().extrude(h)
    def transition(af1,af2,z1,z2):
        return cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z1).polyline(hexagon(af1)).close().workplane(offset=z2-z1).polyline(hexagon(af2)).close().loft()
    eps=p.boolean_overlap
    af=p.nut_af+p.socket_clearance
    outer=af+2*p.spring_wall_t
    relief=outer+2*p.relief_width
    throat=p.nut_af-p.lip_interference
    body=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.knob_d/2).extrude(p.height)
    for i in range(p.scallop_count):
        a=2*math.pi*i/p.scallop_count
        r=p.knob_d/2+p.scallop_center_offset
        cut=cq.Workplane('XY').center(r*math.cos(a),r*math.sin(a)).circle(p.scallop_r).extrude(p.height+eps)
        body=body.cut(cut)
    moat=prism(relief,p.floor_t,p.height-p.floor_t+eps).cut(prism(outer,p.floor_t-eps,p.height-p.floor_t+3*eps))
    body=body.cut(moat)
    cavity=prism(af,p.floor_t,p.lip_under_z-p.floor_t)
    cavity=cavity.union(transition(af,throat,p.lip_under_z,p.lip_throat_z))
    cavity=cavity.union(prism(throat,p.lip_throat_z,p.lip_entry_z-p.lip_throat_z))
    cavity=cavity.union(transition(throat,af,p.lip_entry_z,p.height))
    cavity=cavity.union(prism(af,p.height-eps,2*eps))
    body=body.cut(cavity)
    pedestal=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.pedestal_d/2).extrude(p.nut_bottom_z)
    body=body.union(pedestal)
    for i in range(6):
        length=p.corner_slot_outer_r-p.corner_slot_inner_r
        mid=(p.corner_slot_outer_r+p.corner_slot_inner_r)/2
        slot=cq.Workplane('XY').box(length,p.corner_slot_width,p.height-p.floor_t+eps,centered=(True,True,False)).translate((mid,0,p.floor_t)).rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),30+60*i)
        body=body.cut(slot)
    hole=cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_clearance)/2).extrude(p.height+eps)
    return body.cut(hole)

    def prism(af,z,h):
        return cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z).polyline(hexagon(af)).close().extrude(h)
    def transition(a,b,z,w):
        return cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z).polyline(hexagon(a)).close().workplane(offset=w-z).polyline(hexagon(b)).close().loft()
    e=p.boolean_overlap
    af=p.nut_af+p.socket_clearance

    relief=outer+2*p.relief_width
    throat=p.nut_af-p.lip_interference
    body=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.coupon_d/2).extrude(p.height)
    moat=prism(relief,p.floor_t,p.height-p.floor_t+e).cut(prism(outer,p.floor_t-e,p.height-p.floor_t+3*e))
    body=body.cut(moat)
    cavity=prism(af,p.floor_t,p.lip_under_z-p.floor_t)
    cavity=cavity.union(transition(af,throat,p.lip_under_z,p.lip_throat_z))
    cavity=cavity.union(prism(throat,p.lip_throat_z,p.lip_entry_z-p.lip_throat_z))
    cavity=cavity.union(transition(throat,af,p.lip_entry_z,p.height))
    cavity=cavity.union(prism(af,p.height-e,2*e))
    body=body.cut(cavity).union(cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.pedestal_d/2).extrude(p.nut_bottom_z))
    for i in range(6):
        length=p.corner_slot_outer_r-p.corner_slot_inner_r
        mid=(p.corner_slot_outer_r+p.corner_slot_inner_r)/2

        body=body.cut(slot)
    return body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_clearance)/2).extrude(p.height+e))
